title: sse-streaming-partial-json-token-event-ordering-fix
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: streaming SSE responses for the OpenAI-compat layer could produce malformed partial-JSON payloads under high-throughput batching when delimiter tokens and token/event boundaries were reordered by the streaming framer. This caused downstream clients to observe truncated JSON objects or mis-ordered token event frames. Summary: fix framing and chunking logic in the SSE framer and the OpenAI-compatible streaming adapter to guarantee stable delimiter ordering, explicit token/event boundaries, and deterministic partial-JSON assembly. Changes include: 1) enforce delimiter emission ordering ("data: [token_event]" then "data: [delimiter]"), 2) stabilize internal buffer flush to respect token event boundaries when splitting chunks, 3) add regressions tests that replay incident logs and fuzzed token/event sequences, 4) update SDK adapters to tolerate edge-case trailing delimiters, 5) add observability metrics around framing re-orders and buffer flush counts. Related: ENG-1024 tracks framing regressions; SUP-4532 customer incident with truncated JSON. Checklist: - [x] reproduce failure with unit/integration test harness - [x] add deterministic unit tests for delimiter ordering - [x] update OpenAI compat adapter and SDKs - [x] add metrics and traces for framing flips - [x] run full CI and fix lint/test failures - [x] squash and merge. Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the public API unchanged; behavior is purely correctness/perf-stability.

release_notes: Fix: Stabilize SSE streaming chunking and framing to preserve partial-JSON ordering and token/event boundaries. Prevents truncated JSON for streaming clients and improves compatibility with OpenAI-style streaming adapters. Includes new regression tests and observability metrics.
notes: This is a correctness-first change; we added micro-optimizations to keep perf neutral. Follow-up: add dedicated node smoke tests and monitor sse_framer.reorders metric for 2 weeks.
repro_steps: 1) Replay incident log with streaming harness (tests/streaming/fuzz/fixtures). 2) Run fuzz harness to generate token/event orderings: python3 tests/streaming/fuzz/run_fuzz.py --seed 42. 3) Verify no truncated JSON objects in client-side parser.
impact_assessment: Low-risk runtime change; public API unchanged. Fixes observed customer truncation issues under high QPS streaming workloads. Should reduce error rate for streaming partial-JSON clients.
